tap.description: A tap of lode arms the next key as a gesture, for one second, as if lode were held. Holding still works and is how the map appears.

trigger.description: The physical trigger for every gesture.

active-display.description: How the active display is chosen.

auto-update.description: Keep Lodestar current: check daily, verify the download, apply quietly when idle (installed app only).

channel.description: Which releases updates follow. Stable takes a build once it has run on preview Macs for a few days. Preview takes every build as it ships.

show-menu-bar.description: Show the status item permanently; false hides it until lodestar is picked in the launcher.

sounds.description: Lodestar's own sounds, together: today the draft's note when the microphone is live and when the words land. The alert sound is the Mac's own setting.

start-at-login.description: Keep the login LaunchAgent installed (installed app only).

units.description: The units a copied measurement is read into on its card. Empty follows your region.

gestures.title: GestureSwitches

commands.description: lode - the commands bar, the focused app's verbs

draft.description: lode . speak into the draft, ⇧. revise the field in it

graph.description: lode letter chains to your apps

maximize.description: lode 0 fill the display with the focused window, ⇧0 beside

select.description: lode /, select text by typing it

gestures.description: Every gesture, one switch each; false frees its keys to the app.

browser.description: Bundle id links go to when no route matches (your previous default browser).

enabled.description: Route links clicked in other apps. Set by the menu-bar flow.

fallback.description: most-recent, or a profile as browser:name (brave:Work).

profile.description: A profile as browser:name (omit to route).

search-url.description: Search template; %s becomes the encoded query.

smooth.description: Constant velocity while held; instant stop on release.

step.description: Pixels per press when smooth is off.

copy-on-complete.description: Copy a completed span to the clipboard the moment its second anchor lands. Escape after only the first anchor copies that word.

additionalProperties.description: The browser:name profile this calendar's meetings join in.

calendars.description: Calendar or account name → profile. Outranks web.routes for meetings.

enabled.description: Offer the calendar's next meeting as a chip.

lead-minutes.description: Minutes before the start the chip appears.

enabled.description: ⇧⌘V opens the clipboard strip. The one Lodestar binding outside the lode key, so it is also the one that can collide with an app; false gives ⇧⌘V back.

exclude.description: Substring → true, matched case-insensitively against the clip. The same shape web.routes uses.

exclude-apps.description: Bundle id → true. Nothing copied in these apps is ever written to disk.

max-size-mb.description: Disk the clipboard history may claim; the oldest clips are dropped to stay under it. Pins are never dropped.

save-to.description: The folder an image saved from the clipboard strip lands in. A name typed with a slash in it, or starting with / or ~, chooses another place for that save.

additionalProperties.description: true to read timestamps into this zone too.

time-zones.description: Zone identifier (Asia/Tokyo) → true. A clip that is only a timestamp is read into your zone, UTC, and these.

editor.title: Editor

enabled.description: Mark mistakes as you write; lode ⇥ letters the marks.

language.description: The spelling the editor holds you to. Empty follows the Mac's language and region.

model.description: How the editor reads: spelling (no model, any Mac), minimal (Apple's own model), standard (16 GB Macs and up) or full (64 GB and up). Empty picks the one this Mac suits; one this Mac cannot run falls back the same way.

additionalProperties.description: true to never read fields in this app.

x-stoic-transform.name: lossy dictionary
x-stoic-transform.description: an object whose invalid entries are dropped

skip-apps.description: App name → true. Fields in these apps are never read.

editor.description: The editor: marks under mistakes, lode ⇥ to fix.

observations.title: Observations

health.description: Keep the health record: when each key goes down and how long it is held, by hand, finger and kind of key, and how the pointer moves. No key is stored, but the pattern can partly show what you typed, so it stays on this machine and is included in backups. Independent of the logbook.

health-mb.description: The size Lodestar tells you the health record is nearing. Health is never deleted on its own.

logbook.description: Keep the logbook: how you move between apps, windows and gestures, on this machine only. Sites by name, never their pages, titles or what you type. The coach reads it.

logbook-mb.description: Disk the logbook may claim. Once it is full the oldest months leave first; their monthly summaries stay.

observations.description: What Lodestar observes, in two records with their own switches. Nothing leaves the machine.

coach.title: Coach

enabled.description: Let Lodestar offer one improvement at a time, in quiet moments, priced in seconds.

stand.description: After a stretch of work with no break, a cue to walk for two minutes, at the next natural stopping point. Twice at most in a stretch.

stand-after.description: Minutes of unbroken work before the walk is due. The research supports thirty: two minutes of walking every twenty to thirty minutes.

coach.description: The coach: rare, evidence-backed suggestions drawn from the observations.

additionalProperties.description: The key name this keycode produces.

x-stoic-transform.description: an object whose invalid entries are dropped

keys.description: Keycode → key-name overrides for non-ANSI layouts.

graph.description: lode + letter chains → apps. Values: app name or <browser>:<profile name>.

appearance.title: Appearance

eye-comfort.description: Lodestar adjusts its own surfaces through the day to be easier on your eyes: dimmer and softer after sunset, dimmer still late at night, and quieter when you're not using them. What you copy and view is never changed.

appearance.description: How Lodestar looks. Never what it asks of you.

draft.title: Draft

editing-style.description: How the draft is edited: standard, as in any Mac text field, or vim, the modal editor (esc leaves typing for normal mode).

input.description: The microphone the draft listens to, by its name in Sound settings. Empty follows the system default input.

model.description: The models that hear what you said again and take out the words you take back: apple (Apple's recognizer only), standard (Parakeet and Gemma 4 E2B, 16 GB Macs and up), full (Qwen3-ASR and Gemma 4 E2B, 24 GB and up), max (Qwen3-ASR and Qwen3.6 35B, 64 GB and up). Empty picks the one this Mac suits and fetches it the first time you dictate.

additionalProperties.description: true to keep this word in the draft's vocabulary.

x-stoic-transform.description: an object whose invalid entries are dropped

words.description: Word → true. Names and terms speech gets wrong; a settled result that sounds like one is written as it, case and all.

draft.description: The draft: lode . speaks, lode ⇧. revises.

born.description: Moved to the health record, sealed. A year written here is moved there at launch and taken out of this file.

hand.description: Moved to the health record, sealed. A hand written here is moved there at launch and taken out of this file.

additionalProperties.description: Where the key sits on this keyboard, as a side and a finger: right thumb, either thumb, left pinky.

keyboards.description: Keyboard id (vendor:product:hash, as the Keyboards page shows it) → the keys a split or custom board moves. Letters keep their columns everywhere and are never here.

health.description: About you, for the health record. Local, optional, never sent.

reversed-wheels.description: Source → name. Each source listed has its wheel scrolling opposite to the Mac's setting, and nothing else is turned: a mouse by its id (vendor:product:hash, as Settings, Input, Mice shows it), or an app that posts a mouse's scrolls as app:<bundle id>. The trackpad is never touched.

oneOf.description: An app name, or a profile as browser:name (brave:Work)
